title: Time Traveller Faces
subtitle: Test your understanding of Time Traveller Faces — clone atavism, software-specific faces, and the 520 million true soul quota.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Time Traveller Faces come from clone atavism and shared soul family architecture. About 520 million true souls remain, and the Wizard of Oz Moment reveals that family out of costume.

questions.question: What are the two actual concrete mechanisms that generate viral matches known as Time Traveller Faces?

options.rationale: Viral matches are produced by clone atavism stemming from post-reset repopulation programs and the physical manifestation of shared soul family architecture.

options.rationale: The face is software-specific and clone-linked, not a product of chance makeup.

options.label: D
